title: Long lists and touch scrolling
description: Swipe to browse the options without selecting them. Complete a tap to make a choice.

title: Named-part customization
description: Apply local classes to stable named parts without replacing built-in states. Panel classes follow portalled content.

title: Stable opening near viewport edges
description: A short model menu appears at its measured position. Scroll the page and reopen it to check automatic placement. Source workspace after beta.7; not yet published on npm.

title: A changing container
description: Open the menu after starting the resize. Its width follows the field without resizing the window. Source workspace after beta.7; not yet published on npm.
